summary: Verified the Excel-import Category/Product column-mapping fix (backend + UI). Added a new pytest suite (7 new cases) covering the full column set ('Customer Name, Contact No, Bank, Category, Product, Status, Amount'), fuzzy headers ('Cat'/'Prod', 'Loan Cat Type'/'Prod Name'/'Cust Name'), blank cells and missing columns. Re-ran the existing category/product import suite. All 8 backend tests pass. Confirmed debug logs 'Excel import: detected columns', 'column renames' and 'final columns' are emitted with correct rename maps. UI: logged in as admin, imported the Excel from the MIS Board Import dialog, expanded the month group and confirmed CATEGORY (SECURED/UNSECURED) and PRODUCT (Home Loan/Personal Loan) columns render real values (not '—'), along with contact_no, bank, status and amount. Cleaned up all Sep-2026 / Sep'26 test loans (0 remaining).

minor.issue: When no month is supplied, group_month falls back to datetime.now().strftime("%b'%y") => "Sep'26", which does not match the UI's canonical "MMM-YYYY" group key. Result: a second month group with label Sep'26 that the frontend month-sort regex (/^[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2,4}$/) cannot parse, so it sorts to the bottom. Recommend generating "%b-%Y" (Sep-2026).

integration_issues.issue: The 'Select month for import' dropdown only lists month groups that already exist (only 'Apr-2026' was available). A user importing a new month cannot pick it here and must first use 'Add Month'; otherwise the import silently lands in a backend-generated "Sep'26" group. This is likely how the user's original data ended up in an unexpected group.

issues: Month group labels are inconsistent: 'Apr-2026' vs "Sep'26" in the same list (normalize group_month display via toMonthKey).

action_items: Change the no-month fallback in /api/import/loans-excel from "%b'%y" to "%b-%Y" so group_month matches the UI 'MMM-YYYY' key (or normalize in toMonthKey).
Allow selecting/typing an arbitrary month (or default to the current month in MMM-YYYY) in the import dialog month dropdown.

Optional hardening: the fuzzy matcher substring-matches 'cat' and 'prod', so an unmapped header like 'branch location' or 'product code' could be wrongly renamed to category/product. Prefer token/prefix matching.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py fuzzy_map uses `keyword in col` substring matching: 'cat' matches 'location'/'allocation' and 'prod' matches 'production'. Only 'location' is protected because it is an explicit mapping key; any new unmapped header containing these substrings will be mis-mapped.
MonthlyMIS.jsx is ~2035 lines - should be split into smaller components (table, filters, dialogs).
MIS table cells had no data-testid; added data-testid=`mis-cell-${loan.id}-${field}` for testability.
seed_data_creation: Temporary Sep-2026/Sep'26 loans (TEST_* customers) created via Excel import; all deleted after testing (verified 0 remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Import tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_import_category_product.py and test_import_fuzzy_cat_prod.py (both use month Sep-2026 and auto-clean). Note the frontend nav item is 'Month MIS' (not 'MIS Board'), MIS page testid is mis-board-page, month header testid is month-header-<MMM-YYYY>, cell testid mis-cell-<loanId>-<field>. Import dialog month dropdown only lists existing month groups. Unrelated leftover data 'TEST_Replace_Bank_1' exists in Apr-2026 from an earlier iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Category/Product were empty because the pre-fix column mapping never renamed those headers; data imported before the fix has no category/product stored. The current code maps 'category'/'loan category'/'product'/'product type'/'loan product' plus a fuzzy fallback and works correctly - old rows simply need re-import. Verified end to end.
